SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (5, 6, 7, 8)
  AND f.channel_code = 'WB'
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  d.fiscal_period_label,
  MIN(f.sale_date) AS first_sale,
  MAX(f.sale_date) AS last_sale,
  COUNT(*) AS line_count,
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (5, 6, 7, 8)
  AND f.channel_code = 'WB'
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_period_label
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  d.fiscal_period_label,
  COUNT(*) AS line_count,
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  COALESCE(SUM(f.net_amount), 0) AS net_sales
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar rc
LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON rc.fiscal_year = d.fiscal_year AND rc.fiscal_period = d.fiscal_period
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date AND f.channel_code = 'WB'
WHERE rc.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
  AND rc.fiscal_period IN (5, 6, 7, 8)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, rc.fiscal_period
ORDER BY rc.fiscal_period
